question: While adopting the Constitution of India in 1949, by which Article of the Constitution of India, the Indian Independence Act, 1947, and the Government of India Act, 1935, together with all enactments amending or supplementing the latter Act, EXCEPT the Abolition of Privy Council Jurisdiction Act, 1949 was repealed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**395**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 395** repeals the** Indian Independence Act of 1947 and the Government of India Act of 1935**, as well as all amendments and supplements to the latter Act, except the **Abolition of Privy Council Jurisdiction Act **of **1949**.
 
• The Government of India Act, 1935, abolished the dyarchy established by the Government of India Act, 1919, and established a Federation of India consisting of British India provinces and some or all of the Princely states.
 
• British India was partitioned into India and Pakistan by the Indian Independence Act of 1947.
 
• On July 18, 1947, the Act was signed by** King George VI**, and on August 15, 1947, modern-day Pakistan and India were born.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 394 **states that this article (394) and articles 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 60, 324, 366, 367, 379, 380, 388, 391, 392, and 393 shall enter into force immediately, and the remaining provisions of this Constitution shall enter into force on the twenty-sixth day of January 1950, which is referred to as the Constitution's commencement.
 
• **The original Indian Constitution comprised 395 articles and 22 parts** when it was enacted by the Constituent Assembly in 1949.
